title: Account types
description: The company's kinds of money (cash, banks, credit cards, digital wallets…). Every treasury account has a type, and Treasury shows the business total split by type. A type no longer used is deactivated: accounts that have it keep it.

empty.none: No account types yet. They are created when Treasury is opened, or add your own with "New type".
